stages.title: Data foundation
stages.question: Can it collect, prepare, route and retain the data your team needs?
stages.description: Move telemetry from its sources through a usable data pipeline. Distinguish the product's own storage and retention from a connected SIEM or data lake.
checks: Retention periods, storage tiers, retrieval and deletion

stages.title: Detection and readiness
stages.question: Can it detect threats and keep detections, telemetry and context ready?
stages.description: Run detection engines, build and validate detection content, verify operational coverage, and build or maintain security context. A context database is not automatically a graph.
checks: Detection execution versus authoring rules for another engine
Attack simulation, validation and SecOps resilience
Context collection, storage, relationships, freshness and provenance

stages.title: Investigation and understanding
stages.question: Can it turn signals and context into a defensible understanding of the incident?
stages.description: Use context to enrich, correlate and deduplicate signals, investigate incidents, perform forensics and hunt for threats. Cover proactive and reactive hunting; feed findings back into detection engineering.
checks: Enrichment, correlation and deduplication, including upstream dependencies
DFIR, evidence integrity and chain of custody

stages.title: Remediation and improvements
stages.question: Can it limit harm, remediate the cause and restore operations safely?
stages.description: Contain or mitigate the threat, remediate its cause and verify recovery. Separate actions shipped with the product from workflows the customer must build. Feedback alone does not demonstrate mitigation or remediation coverage.
checks: Human approval, guardrails and customer-owned processes

crossCutting.title: Platform and Trust
crossCutting.description: Evaluate deployment, operations, security and governance across the selected offering.

crossCutting.title: Feedback and implemented improvements
crossCutting.description: Verify how outcomes inform changes across the lifecycle. Feedback alone does not imply Right-stage placement or autonomous remediation.
